name: Tears of Joy, Mass
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 3, medium 4, mesmerist 3, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as tears of joy except it affects multiple creatures.
